verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a free, open-source self-hosted deployment (sentry-docs-11/26/37/38/39) and one long-time HN user reports it as 'rock-solid' (sentry-comm-2), but concrete hands-on community reports contradict the ease-of-self-hosting claim: post-Clickhouse migration self-hosted Sentry is described as spawning excessive containers that consume all server memory (sentry-comm-5), leading multiple teams to switch to lighter alternatives like GlitchTip or Bugsink due to maintenance burden (sentry-comm-6/7/8/9). missing for 10: independent verification that current self-hosted releases are lightweight/maintainable, and reconciliation of the resource-consumption complaints with vendor docs.
